claim.quote: By achieving a low energy threshold of 1 keV$_{ee}$ and a background level of 80 counts keV$^{-1}$ Kg$^{-1}$ day$^{-1}$ in the region from 1 to 7 keV$_{ee}$, the experiment demonstrates its potential to search for low-mass WIMPs.

name: Searching for WIMPs with TREX-DM: achievements and challenges

summary.plain: After years of data taking underground, TREX-DM reached a 1 keV energy threshold and a background level of 80 counts per keV per kg per day, which the team says shows its potential for light WIMPs.
summary.technical: Data-taking campaigns with argon and neon mixtures at 1 to 4 bar since the 2018 commissioning; the paper also describes the Micromegas + GEM readout under development and the alpha-detector programme for material selection.

title: Searching for WIMPs with TREX-DM: achievements and challenges
why_it_matters: The abstract says the two main challenges are reducing both the background level and the energy threshold.
